distribution.narrative: Beaver & Liu (2010) reports China (NE) and Taiwan. The broad northeastern-China wording supports Mainland China = Present but is not expanded into provinces. Taiwan was historically recorded under the synonym Scolytus formosanus Eggers and is accepted by Beaver & Liu as S. frontalis.

host_note: Usually Ulmus and Zelkova, with Quercus and Prunus also reported; all are retained at genus level and no species-level host is inferred.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus frontalis Blandford, 1894.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytus formosanus
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 115.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytus frontalis
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Current identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Scolytus frontalis Blandford, 1894, VSN_5501. The Taiwan evidence was published historically under Scolytus formosanus Eggers; that nomenclatural provenance is retained without creating a separate taxon.
